purpose: Decode the callers that activate the Level 01 interaction-row processors and explain why a forced interaction-table byte does not dispatch until the camera refill path runs.

horizontal_camera_refill.deadband: If (u16(CAMERA_SCROLL_X + 0x100) < 0x110) and the adjusted value is > 0xF0, return without processing a row.
horizontal_camera_refill.refill_effect: Outside the deadband, move CAMERA_SCROLL_X and CAMERA_REFERENCE_X by 0x10, compute the terrain row pointer from CAMERA_REFERENCE_Y and CAMERA_REFERENCE_X, refill the VDP row, then call 0x001AE3FC.

vertical_camera_refill.deadband: If (u16(CAMERA_SCROLL_Y + 0x100) < 0x110) and the adjusted value is > 0xF0, return without processing a row.
vertical_camera_refill.refill_effect: Outside the deadband, move CAMERA_SCROLL_Y and CAMERA_REFERENCE_Y by 0x10, compute the terrain row pointer from CAMERA_REFERENCE_Y and CAMERA_REFERENCE_X, refill the VDP column, then call 0x001AE47E.

horizontal_processor.dispatch: Nonzero c selects INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE + (c << 2), then passes the map index and interaction byte to the handler.

vertical_processor.dispatch: Nonzero c selects INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE + (c << 2), then passes the map index and interaction byte to the handler.

direct_refill_variants.meaning: Direct horizontal row processor with the 0x150 by 0xF0 interaction window.
Direct vertical row processor with the 0xF0 by 0x1E0 interaction window.

interpretation: The interaction table is not generically scanned every simulation frame by these routines; the row processors are reached through camera refill paths.
The earlier forced 0x80 byte run kept the relevant camera field inside the return deadband, so observing the byte in RAM did not imply handler dispatch.

The controlled refill run crosses the caller path and reaches 0x001B6F0C, proving that the handler is live and that the missing activation is a row-pointer/camera-context problem rather than a globally inactive handler.
limitations: The dispatch-proof run intentionally pokes camera and player fields and then drifts from the natural route.
Its row word 0x1180 and logged runtime index 0x2FB4 are not the expected Level 01 map record 0x5630/index 0x2B18.
No natural Level 01 route has yet been shown to dispatch the sole map-cell (249,14) selector 0x80.
next_action: Capture a natural camera scroll across the map-cell (249,14) window, or reproduce the exact terrain-row pointer and interaction index 0x2B18 at a refill boundary; then trace 0x001B6F0C through 0x001B525E, actor allocation, and FFF104.
